text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh, I slept great! I'm ready to bump up the excitement!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh, wait a sec… Looks like I woke up early.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm… There's still time before training. What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! I'll use the extra time to do some maintenance on my mountain bike.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right—with that decided, I'd better get started as quick as I can!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Working on my bike is pretty fun! I can't wait to ride it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I haven't really tinkered with it recently. There's so many parts I wanna change!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Raaagh! Can't stop now—I'm on fire!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Winning Ticket gets so absorbed in her mountain bike that she totally forgets about training.
